basis: Infantile epilepsy defined by myoclonic seizures; developmental and cognitive manifestations remain within the neurologic axis.
Neoplasm arising in or occupying the esophagus; no other organ involvement defines this umbrella.
Developmental encephalopathy and syndactyly define the syndrome; macular degeneration and choroidal neovascularization occur in 30-79%.
Inherited striatal degeneration; optic atrophy occurs in 30-79%. Dysphagia and weakness reflect neurologic disease rather than separate gut or muscle damage.
Disrupted glycosylation defines a metabolic disorder; the heterogeneous umbrella does not establish a shared additional damaged organ.
Craniosynostosis and limb malformations define Pfeiffer syndrome; conductive hearing loss from ear abnormalities affects about 50%. Neurologic injury varies by severity.
Occlusion of the vertebral artery; cerebral infarction is a separate complication and is not inherent in this concept.
CNGB3-related retinal cone dysfunction causes achromatopsia, photophobia and reduced visual acuity.
Inherited hypertrophy and obstruction of the gastric pylorus; no additional organ damage is established.
Defining intestinal hypoperistalsis and microcolon accompany a dysfunctional enlarged urinary bladder; visceral smooth muscle is outside the skeletal-muscle axis.
Neurodevelopmental impairment is the principal shared manifestation of chromosome 5 deletion syndromes; other organ anomalies depend on the deleted region.
Microcephaly and cleft palate define the syndrome. Retinal pigmentation changes and finger contractures occur in only 5-29%.
The concept is explicitly located in the cornea; additional organ disease cannot be inferred from a corneal deposit.
Defining limb malformations; cleft palate 30-79%, hearing impairment 35%, intellectual disability 33%. Cardiovascular anomalies at 13% are excluded.
Autosomal recessive nonsyndromic sensorineural hearing loss; no extra-auditory disease is established.
Congenital structural skeletal myopathy; respiratory insufficiency is due to muscle weakness. Cardiomyopathy is reported without a qualifying frequency.
Abnormal spacing of the medial eyelid canthi; classified as an eyelid disorder. Syndromic children's other organs do not apply to this umbrella.
ADA purine-metabolism defect causes profound lymphocyte depletion and SCID. Pneumonia and otitis are separate infections; intrinsic lung injury frequency is uncertain.
UMP synthesis defect with megaloblastic anemia; developmental delay 80-99%, T-cell dysfunction 30-79%. Hip, ureter and cardiac anomalies omitted by cap; crystalluria alone is not injury.
Occlusion confined to the female genital tract, which is outside the 13 axes.
Hereditary colorectal cancer syndrome; extracolonic tumors are separately diagnosed cancers arising from increased risk, not direct organ involvement.
Clonal plasma-cell myeloma explicitly lacking organ impairment; bone and renal damage would contradict the smoldering disease definition.
Mitochondrial metabolic encephalomyopathy defines MELAS; sensorineural hearing loss affects roughly 40-60% in MELAS overall. MTTK-specific frequencies are uncertain.
Peroxisome biogenesis defect; brain, liver and retinal dysfunction are common in Zellweger spectrum (each >=30%). Hearing loss omitted by cap; PEX16 severity varies.
Meningioma involving skin, including primary cutaneous tumors; intracranial occupation is not established across this concept.
